decision.reasoning_trace: Selected products based on high ratings, reviews, and relevance to the category of mechanical keyboards. The consideration set includes keyboards with Cherry MX switches, wireless options, and custom keycap sets. The final choice, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, offers a full-size 104-key layout, 26 rainbow backlights, and an ergonomic design, making it a well-rounded option for customers seeking a mechanical keyboard.
